overall_reason: The hero retention chart is a readable, labelled product illustration, but the logo row is six placeholder names typed in the page font and the small feature charts carry no values.

score.reason: T-ILLUSTRATION-READ passes on the hero cohort chart, but T-LOGO-ROW fails on the typed logo row and T-DELETION finds the feature-row sparklines carry no fact (IMG-014, IMG-003).

findings.title: Logos are the owners' marks at even weight
findings.where: 'Trusted by fast-moving teams at' row, about y 690 of the 1280 image
findings.evidence: The logo row sets six names (Northwind, Lumen, Vertex, Quanta, Beacon, Atlas) as dark bold text in the page font, not as marks. Northwind is a well-known sample-company name. Whether these customers exist belongs to SLP-016 and INT-010 (lens-integrity).
findings.before: Six placeholder names typed in the page font.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: the real customers' one-colour marks at one optical height], or remove the row until real customers agree to appear.
findings.why: A row of typed names in the house font shows that no owner supplied a mark, so it reads as a template slot directly under the hero.

findings.title: Every picture carries a fact
findings.where: feature rows, right column, about x 1040 to 1240 and y 960 to 1110 of the 1280 image
findings.evidence: The 'Live dashboards' row ends in a 200 by 30px sparkline captioned 'events in the last hour' with no axis or count, and the 'Funnels & retention' row ends in three bars captioned 'visit, sign up, invite' with no values. Removing either leaves the row's meaning unchanged.
findings.before: A valueless sparkline and three valueless bars.
findings.after: Give each a number the reader can take away (for example '1,204 events in the last hour' and '62% to 31% to 12%'), or drop them and keep the hero chart as the one picture.
findings.why: A chart with no values is decoration on a page that sells answers from data.

strengths: The hero 'Weekly retention by signup week' chart reads at its size: labelled rows and weeks, a value in every cell, a correct triangular cohort shape (Aug 25 has only week 0), and a legend from 'Fewer' to 'More still active'.
The third feature row uses a real annotation ('Maya annotated Tuesday, New onboarding shipped, activation up') in place of an icon, which shows the feature.
No emoji, icon tiles, gradients or glows; the footer social links are plain text.
not_investigated: image-only item: natural sizes, hosts, file names, alt text, density, crops at 375 and the sweep's per-element hits (fake_people, img_alt, mixed_icons, emoji_icons, icon_tile, gradient, glow, performance) were not captured; T-IMAGE-SIZE and T-CROP-375 were judged only from what the one image shows
the whole artifact is one screenshot, so it is one sample; confidence is medium at most
licences and credits: the capture cannot see licences
menus, carousels, tabs, hover states and lazy content: no interaction was captured
art direction at other widths: only one width exists
T-CAPTURE-READ: no product capture; the hero chart is an illustration, judged with T-ILLUSTRATION-READ (C48)
T-TEXT-ON-IMAGE: no text over a picture
the 12,000+, 8B, 4.9 and 99.99% figures and the customer names belong to lens-integrity
